{{Quote|Anyway, no we don't have a bounty on him, but I know this guy over in Velex City who'll ship him back to Seswenna Sector for next to nothing and I figure we can get 10,000 for him if you're interested.|Licensed Expeditor Minas Derel|<ref name="MIH">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters|story=Makin' It Happen}}</ref>}}
